## Summary

A clear and concise description of what went wrong.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Launch mode (e.g., Windows `.exe` launcher or `npm run dev`)
2. Open Lichii and load Ocarina of Time (`0400486024DEC000`)
3. Enter area / floor / action taken
4. Observe the issue

## Expected Behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior

What actually happened (include any error messages, toast notifications, or status bar text such as `Lichii · Live`, `Lichii · Waiting for game`, `Lichii · Save only`, or `Lichii · Disconnected`).
